## Intent — what this is for

§5.4 Widget trees feeding actions back into execution (dual payloads; continue-conversation / gate resolution / tile re-fire); §5.1 app-extension (manifest ui components via appSdk host-module map); §6 Layered Surface Overlay (L0/L1/L2) + Safe Mode; typed-questionnaire consumer.

## Done when

genui component actions emit dual payloads (llmFriendlyMessage + humanFriendlyMessage); a chat-born widget action becomes the next user turn showing humanFriendlyMessage (not raw JSON); a workflow-gate-emitted form widget submission resolves the run's wait node so the run advances; tile-widget actions re-fire the bound workflow within the trigger's frozen capability set; an installed app registers a genui component that appears in generated UIs and is removed on disable, and an attempt to shadow a core component name is refused at register time; each L1/L2 layer load is error-boundaried and #/dashboard?safe=1 (plus a --safe-surfaces gateway flag) forces maxLayer=0 pure-L0.
